request.description: Software engineer considering a move from San Francisco (CA) to Austin (TX) at $150k salary

expected_response.summary: Moving from CA to TX saves ~$9,870/year in state income taxes and your cost of living drops ~32%, giving you roughly $101,850 of equivalent purchasing power in Texas.

recommendations.message: Texas has no state income tax — moving saves you $822/month ($9,870/year) compared to California.
Austin's cost of living is about 32% lower than San Francisco; your housing, groceries, and everyday expenses should drop significantly.
Your $150k California salary has the purchasing power of ~$102k in Austin. If you're negotiating a new role, be mindful of location-adjusted offers.
Consider redirecting the state tax savings ($822/month) into retirement or taxable investments — you could reach your financial goals years sooner.
